combo_label: Things That Beep × At the Funfair × Heists & Capers

entries.clue: Little electric cars with rubber skirts, steered straight at your mates
Fake moustache and janitor's overalls, professionally speaking
Checkout gun that beeps at each barcode and judges your snack haul.
Chairs on chains that fly outward as the ride picks up speed
Long night in a parked car with cold coffee, watching the door
Proof you were somewhere else entirely when it happened, honest
Ping. Pause. Ping. A submarine asking the dark whether anyone is out there.
Kitchen rumbler that clicks, chirps, and refuses to boil while you watch it.
Shop's chirping cash drawer, springing open with a triumphant ding.
Trader's pitch under canvas, or what an engine does when it conks out
